Class AbstractOracleTypeConvertersFactory

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.convert.vector.impl.AbstractOracleTypeConvertersFactory
@Internal public abstract class AbstractOracleTypeConvertersFactory extends Object
Shared helpers for Oracle VECTOR converters. This class intentionally avoids any dependency on Oracle driver or Micronaut runtime types. Methods are protected static so vendor-specific factories can reuse them. This type is intentionally non-sealed because concrete Oracle converter factories live in JDBC and R2DBC modules.
Since:
5.0.0
Author:
Nemanja Mikic
